wholePhysicalScope: Use the named survey outline for the three ranges and round towers, the local site-height record for the great tower, and the two exact Qualla exteriors for roof colors, floor divisions, window types and decorative banding.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the west-open courtyard, three brick ranges and six circular towers.
limitations: Minor roof slopes, decorative brick divisions and elevations beyond the two source views are reconstructed at the fidelity appropriate for Earth view.
The model covers the castle proper. The separate granary, mill and estate park are outside its footprint.
